title: Hertz Fellowship
about: The Hertz Foundation's 2027 Hertz Fellowship application opened on August 31, 2026. Recommender forms are due November 2, 2026; finalists are named in February 2027 and awards are announced in May 2027. Awards provide up to five years of funding.
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the Hertz Fellowship offered by the Hertz Foundation in the United States, application deadline 30 Oct 2026. The photo shows the Statue of Liberty in front of the Manhattan skyline with the Empire State Building, New York.
